source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Software Development Methodologies (PDF 10).

blocks.text: Software development methodologies software banane ke munazzam (structured) tareeqe hain jo software projects ki planning, banane (creation) aur management mein rehnumai karte hain. Yeh yaqeeni banate hain ke development ka process tarteeb wala (systematic) aur efficient ho, aur us se high-quality software bane.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Is chapter mein aage yeh methodologies aati hain: Waterfall Model, Agile Methodology, Scrum, Lean aur DevOps.

blocks.prompt: Software development methodologies kis cheez mein rehnumai karti hain?
blocks.explanation: Software projects ki planning, banane (creation) aur management mein; is se process systematic aur efficient hota hai aur high-quality software banta hai.

items: Methodologies: software projects ki planning, creation aur management ke structured tareeqe.
Is chapter mein: Waterfall, Agile, Scrum, Lean, DevOps.
